steps.en: Owner notices that are due for the first reminder are selected
steps.id: Notice pemilik yang jatuh tempo untuk reminder pertama dipilih
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: Special vehicle and ID types are kept out of this letter
steps.id: Jenis kendaraan dan ID khusus tidak dikirimi letter ini
steps.why_en: Only foreign vehicles are held back at this stage; military and diplomatic ones still get the letter.
steps.why_id: Pada tahap ini hanya kendaraan asing yang ditahan; kendaraan militer dan diplomat tetap dapat letter.

steps.en: A letter data file is built for the printing vendor
steps.id: File data letter dibuat untuk vendor cetak

steps.en: The file goes to the vendor for printing and posting
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor untuk dicetak dan diposkan
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is switched off in all configured environments, so the file does not reach them.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di semua environment yang terkonfigurasi, jadi file tidak sampai.

steps.en: The notice moves to the next stage once the letter is sent
steps.id: Notice lanjut ke tahap berikutnya setelah letter dikirim
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the file never reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap lanjut walaupun file tidak pernah sampai ke vendor.
